items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: I played with him with Nelson Riddle, and then Nat Cole and did a few recordings and with Duke Ellington

ctx.x: Oh, he was a good trombone player. I played with him with Nelson Riddle, and then Nat Cole and did a few recordings and with Duke Ellington, he was the first trombone player, and he was a good man. I liked him -- he did a lot of work around here.
Juan, this was taken in New York. Because it has on the back of it, Please credit Bill Marks, 79 Riverside Drive, New York 29, New York.
